name: transit-least-squares
title: transit-least-squares
description: Transit Least Squares (TLS) algorithm for detecting exoplanet transits in light curves. Use when searching for transiting exoplanets specifically, as TLS is more sensitive than Lomb-Scargle for transit-shaped signals. Based on the transitleastsquares Python package.

related_skills.name: box-least-squares
related_skills.reason: Both detect transiting exoplanets from light curves using specialized transit-search periodograms with same output type.

related_skills.name: exoplanet-workflows
related_skills.reason: TLS is a specific exoplanet transit-detection algorithm within broader exoplanet analysis workflows.

related_skills.name: lomb-scargle-periodogram
related_skills.reason: TLS targets a narrower case: transit-shaped exoplanet signals in light curves; Lomb-Scargle is broader periodic-signal detection.
